title: React Application Architect
description:
About You

You are an Application Architect specializing in marketing technology and digital analytics platforms. You enjoy designing scalable, privacy-compliant architectures that enable reliable data collection, attribution, and measurement across complex digital ecosystems. You take ownership of architectural decisions, think in systems, and balance technical rigor with business impact.

You are comfortable operating across marketing, analytics, and engineering teams, translating complex technical concepts into clear guidance, and defining standards that improve data quality, performance, and long-term maintainability.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of experience in application architecture, marketing technology, or analytics engineering roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of React , JavaScript, HTML, and CSS to implement and debug complex tracking solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency with Google Tag Manager, including custom JavaScript variables and structured data layer implementations.
  • Strong experience implementing and governing Google Analytics 4, including event modeling and advanced tracking strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with Facebook Business Manager, Facebook Pixel, and Conversions API.
  • Solid understanding of Google Ads conversion tracking and remarketing integrations.
  • Proven experience designing client-side and server-side tracking architectures.
  • Strong understanding of privacy regulations, Consent Mode, and browser restrictions (ITP) and their impact on data collection.
  • Experience using browser developer tools and tag debugging extensions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Architect and implement a modular, scalable application architecture for marketing data collection and digital analytics.
  • Own and optimize advanced Google Tag Manager configurations, including tags, triggers, variables, and structured data layers.
  • Govern tracking implementations across Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, and Facebook Pixel, including Conversions API integrations.
  • Design tracking solutions resilient to browser privacy restrictions and compliant with global privacy regulations.
  • Lead the transition from fragmented client-side tracking to robust server-side and API-driven architectures when appropriate.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex, production-level tracking and performance issues affecting data accuracy or site stability.
  • Conduct regular audits to ensure data accuracy, attribution integrity, and alignment with business and marketing objectives.
  • Collaborate closely with marketing, analytics, and engineering teams to document requirements and implement new tracking solutions.
  • Optimize tracking implementations to protect and improve Core Web Vitals and overall site performance.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation and architecture standards related to tracking, performance, and system reliability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in application architecture or marketing technology roles.
  • 5+ years of experience with React.
  • Advanced experience with Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4.
  • Strong experience with Facebook Pixel and Conversions API.
  • Solid JavaScript knowledge for tracking implementations.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Engenheiros de IA
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Graphic Designer (Toys and Baby Gear)
description:
About Us:

Move2Play is a rapidly growing kids toy company in the e-commerce space. We were founded with a mission to create unique, interactive toys that get kids moving. We're a small but enthusiastic team that likes to work hard, move quickly, and bring thoughtful, engaging products to families across the country.


As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a talented Graphic Designer to help shape the visual identity of our products from concept to shelf.


Job Description:

We are seeking a talented and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our team. This role focuses on graphic design execution for toys and baby gear products — including packaging, print artwork, character illustration, surface graphics, color studies, and visual concept development.


The ideal candidate has strong illustration skills, a sharp eye for color and composition, and experience creating graphics that resonate with both kids and modern parents. This is not an industrial design or soft goods design role — it is a graphics-first position embedded within product development.


**Portfolio or personal website is required.

**Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.


Salary:

30-40K USD | 5-15% Bonus



Responsibilities:

  • Create original character illustrations and playful graphics for toys and baby products
  • Develop surface artwork for products (prints, patterns, decals, labels, etc.)
  • Conduct color studies and create cohesive color palettes across product lines
  • Prepare production-ready print files and packaging dielines
  • Collaborate closely with product designers, brand designers, engineers, and overseas manufacturers to ensure accurate execution
  • Develop instruction manuals, inserts, and other printed collateral
  • Design engaging retail packaging, including layout, typography, callouts, and compliance elements
  • Contribute to new product concepts with visual mockups and graphic direction
  • Maintain brand consistency across all product graphics
  • Stay up-to-date on design trends in toys, baby gear, illustration, and packaging
  • *Leverage AI platforms to enhance and expand design design tasks


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Illustration, or related field
  • 4+ years of experience in graphic design - experience in toys, baby products, or other consumer products is required.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator and Photoshop required; InDesign strongly preferred)
  • Strong illustration skills (vector and/or hand-drawn style)
  • Experience preparing print-ready files and working with packaging dielines
  • Solid understanding of typography, color theory, and composition
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and move quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong attention to detail and organization
  • Experience working with overseas manufacturers is a plus
  • Passion for children’s products and understanding of what appeals to both kids and parents
  • *Experience working with AI platforms to improve design outputs


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience designing retail packaging for Amazon or mass retail
  • Experience with character development and brand mascots
  • Familiarity with basic 3D mockups or rendering tools
  • Understanding of toy safety labeling requirements
  • Experience working with licensed IP


Benefits:

  • Fully remote position
  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Creative and collaborative work environment
  • Opportunity to directly shape products sold nationally and internationally


  • If you’re a graphic designer who loves illustration, packaging, and creating playful yet beautiful products for kids and families, we’d love to hear from you!

  • Prepare production-ready print files and packaging dielines
  • Collaborate closely with product designers, brand designers, engineers, and overseas manufacturers to ensure accurate execution
  • Develop instruction manuals, inserts, and other printed collateral
  • Design engaging retail packaging, including layout, typography, callouts, and compliance elements
  • Contribute to new product concepts with visual mockups and graphic direction
  • Maintain brand consistency across all product graphics
  • Stay up-to-date on design trends in toys, baby gear, illustration, and packaging
  • *Leverage AI platforms to enhance and expand design design tasks


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Illustration, or related field
  • 4+ years of experience in graphic design - experience in toys, baby products, or other consumer products is required.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator and Photoshop required; InDesign strongly preferred)
  • Strong illustration skills (vector and/or hand-drawn style)
  • Experience preparing print-ready files and working with packaging dielines
  • Solid understanding of typography, color theory, and composition
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and move quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong attention to detail and organization
  • Experience working with overseas manufacturers is a plus
  • Passion for children’s products and understanding of what appeals to both kids and parents
  • *Experience working with AI platforms to improve design outputs


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience designing retail packaging for Amazon or mass retail
  • Experience with character development and brand mascots
  • Familiarity with basic 3D mockups or rendering tools
  • Understanding of toy safety labeling requirements
  • Experience working with licensed IP


Benefits:

  • Fully remote position
  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Creative and collaborative work environment
  • Opportunity to directly shape products sold nationally and internationally


  • If you’re a graphic designer who loves illustration, packaging, and creating playful yet beautiful products for kids and families, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Job Description

Join codevista as an entry-level Full Stack Developer - JavaScript in a fully remote role. Build and maintain web applications using modern JavaScript technologies like React and Node.js. Enjoy the flexibility of working from anywhere in Brazil, with collaborative tools and a supportive team environment tailored for beginners eager to grow their skills.

As an entry-level Full Stack Developer - JavaScript at codevista, you'll dive into the exciting world of web development while working remotely from anywhere in Brazil. This role is perfect for recent graduates or those with basic programming experience who are passionate about JavaScript and ready to contribute to real-world projects.

Your primary responsibilities will include developing user-facing features using frontend frameworks like React or Vue.js, integrating with backend services built on Node.js and Express, and working with databases such as MongoDB or PostgreSQL. You'll collaborate on building scalable web applications, fixing bugs, and optimizing performance for our clients' needs. Since this is an entry-level position, expect hands-on guidance from senior developers to help you learn best practices in agile methodologies and version control with Git.

Remote work is at the core of our setup at codevista. You'll use tools like Slack for daily communication, Zoom for team meetings and stand-ups, and Jira or Trello for task tracking. We foster a collaborative culture through virtual pair programming sessions and weekly knowledge-sharing calls, ensuring you're never isolated despite the distance. Time zones are considered, with core hours aligned to São Paulo time for seamless teamwork.

Technologies you'll work with include HTML5, CSS3 (with preprocessors like Sass), JavaScript (ES6+), and RESTful APIs. On the backend, you'll handle authentication, data validation, and deployment using platforms like Heroku or AWS basics. For an entry-level role, we emphasize learning over perfection—expect mentorship to build your foundational skills in full-stack development.

This position offers a supportive environment to grow your career. You'll participate in code reviews to understand clean code principles and contribute to open-source inspired projects internally. Remote flexibility means you can balance work with personal life, while our team ensures regular feedback to accelerate your professional development. Join us to turn your JavaScript passion into a rewarding remote career at codevista.

Requirements

  • Basic knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Familiarity with at least one frontend framework (e.g., React) and backend runtime (e.g., Node.js)
  • Understanding of REST APIs and basic database concepts
  • Strong self-motivation and time management skills for independent remote work
  • Excellent communication abilities for virtual team collaboration
  • Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace

Your primary responsibilities will include developing user-facing features using frontend frameworks like React or Vue.js, integrating with backend services built on Node.js and Express, and working with databases such as MongoDB or PostgreSQL. You'll collaborate on building scalable web applications, fixing bugs, and optimizing performance for our clients' needs. Since this is an entry-level position, expect hands-on guidance from senior developers to help you learn best practices in agile methodologies and version control with Git.

We foster a collaborative culture through virtual pair programming sessions and weekly knowledge-sharing calls, ensuring you're never isolated despite the distance. Technologies you'll work with include HTML5, CSS3 (with preprocessors like Sass), JavaScript (ES6+), and RESTful APIs. On the backend, you'll handle authentication, data validation, and deployment using platforms like Heroku or AWS basics. For an entry-level role, we emphasize learning over perfection—expect mentorship to build your foundational skills in full-stack development.

This position offers a supportive environment to grow your career. You'll participate in code reviews to understand clean code principles and contribute to open-source inspired projects internally. Remote flexibility means you can balance work with personal life, while our team ensures regular feedback to accelerate your professional development. Join us to turn your JavaScript passion into a rewarding remote career at codevista.

  • Familiarity with at least one frontend framework (e.g., React) and backend runtime (e.g., Node.js)

  • Strong self-motivation and time management skills for independent remote work
  • Excellent communication abilities for virtual team collaboration
  • Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace

title: Arquiteto .Net
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de microsserviços robustas, escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Aplicar os princípios de Domain-Driven Design (DDD) e Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) para modelar sistemas complexos.
  • Definir a estratégia de containerização e orquestração de serviços, garantindo a portabilidade e a alta disponibilidade.
  • Garantir a observabilidade das soluções, implementando ferramentas e práticas de monitoramento, tracing e logging.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções com foco em Clean Architecture e na cultura de testes de software para assegurar a qualidade e a confiabilidade do código.
  • Explorar e propor novas tecnologias e abordagens para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência como Arquiteto de Software ou em papéis semelhantes, com forte background em tecnologias Microsoft (.NET Core).
  • Conhecimento em: containerização e orquestração de contêineres (Docker, OpenShift e etc.)
  • Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Event-Driven Architecture (EDA).
  • Clean Architecture.
  • Microservices.
  • Testes de software (TDD, BDD, etc.).
  • Observabilidade (ex.: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack ou equivalentes).
  • Experiência em ambientes de inovação, como prototipagem rápida, experimentação com novas ferramentas e integração de IA/ML é um diferencial.
  • Formação em Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins.
  • Habilidades de comunicação excelentes, com capacidade de mentorar equipes e apresentar soluções técnicas.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Executivo(a) de Vendas – Remoto

EAD Marketing & Assessoria


Sobre a Empresa

A EAD Marketing & Assessoria é uma empresa especializada na comercialização de produtos de alto valor no mercado digital, atuando com estratégias estruturadas de vendas e relacionamento com clientes.


Descrição do Cargo

Estamos em busca de um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas para atuação remota, com foco na condução do processo comercial do início ao fechamento.


Este(a) profissional será responsável por gerenciar o relacionamento com leads e clientes, identificar oportunidades de negócio e apresentar soluções personalizadas de acordo com as necessidades de cada perfil.


Principais Responsabilidades
  • Conduzir reuniões comerciais por vídeo chamada;
  • Realizar follow-ups estruturados ao longo do ciclo de vendas;
  • Gerenciar pipeline e registros no CRM;
  • Qualificar oportunidades e conduzir negociações;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho e metas comerciais;
  • Contribuir para o crescimento sustentável da área de vendas.

    • Requisitos
    • Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas ou fechamento de contratos;
    • Vivência com metas comerciais e acompanhamento de indicadores;
    • Boa organização para gestão de pipeline e CRM;
    • Comunicação verbal e escrita clara e profissional;
    • Capacidade de conduzir negociações de forma estruturada.

    • Diferenciais
    • Experiência no mercado de marketing digital ou infoprodutos;
    • Conhecimento prático em ferramentas de CRM;
    • Experiência com produtos de maior valor agregado.

    • Modelo de Trabalho
    • Atuação 100% remota
    • Remuneração fixa + variável por desempenho
    • Possibilidade de crescimento interno conforme resultados e evolução profissional

title: Node Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


The Node Developer position requires a problem solver who combines experience, knowledge, and independence to tackle complex tasks. This role involves architecting backend systems, implementing features at a rapid pace, and contributing to building a world-class engineering team while maintaining high standards of code quality and innovation.


Key responsibilities:


- Architecting backend systems using best practices.

- Implementing and iterating features strategically.

- Working collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast-paced early-stage startup environment.

- Designing, extending, and implementing APIs.

- Maintaining high engineering quality standards through code reviews, unit tests, and analytics.

- Improving engineering productivity through automation and tool development.

- Defining engineering processes for product launches and releases.

- Helping grow the engineering team by conducting technical interviews.


Requirements:


- Node.js Experience: 5+ years of experience in Node development.

- Database Skills: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.

- Architecture Knowledge: Experience with microservices and cloud platforms.

- Algorithm Proficiency: Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Infrastructure Understanding: IT infrastructure knowledge.

- Agile Methodology: Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Best Practices: Strong understanding of SOLID principles, clean code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns: Knowledge of software design patterns.

- Application Development: Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Testing & Deployment: Experience in automated tests and CI/CD pipelines.

- Version Control: Strong experience with version control systems.

- Language Skills: Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


The Node Developer position requires a problem solver who combines experience, knowledge, and independence to tackle complex tasks. This role involves architecting backend systems, implementing features at a rapid pace, and contributing to building a world-class engineering team while maintaining high standards of code quality and innovation.


Key responsibilities:


- Architecting backend systems using best practices.

- Implementing and iterating features strategically.

- Working collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast-paced early-stage startup environment.

- Designing, extending, and implementing APIs.

- Maintaining high engineering quality standards through code reviews, unit tests, and analytics.

- Improving engineering productivity through automation and tool development.

- Defining engineering processes for product launches and releases.

- Helping grow the engineering team by conducting technical interviews.


Requirements:


- Node.js Experience: 5+ years of experience in Node development.

- Database Skills: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.

- Architecture Knowledge: Experience with microservices and cloud platforms.

- Algorithm Proficiency: Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Infrastructure Understanding: IT infrastructure knowledge.

- Agile Methodology: Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Best Practices: Strong understanding of SOLID principles, clean code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns: Knowledge of software design patterns.

- Application Development: Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Testing & Deployment: Experience in automated tests and CI/CD pipelines.

- Version Control: Strong experience with version control systems.

- Language Skills: Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.



Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. By applying for a role at Sportingtech, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of our Candidates and Employees Privacy Policy. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

description:
Python GCP Developer


Language: Portuguese & English

Position: Remote

Experience: Mid to Senior


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement serverless cloud solutions using GCP Cloud Functions;
  • Design data models and manage largescale data storage with GCP Bigtable;
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to cloud functions and associated services;
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to automate deployment and monitoring of cloud functions;
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance cloud infrastructure and application performance;
  • Mentor and support team members in adopting best practices for Python and GCP development;
  • Document technical designs processes and best practices for knowledge sharing;
  • Engage with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions;
  • Ensure adherence to security best practices in cloud deployments;
  • Stay updated with the latest GCP advancements and industry trends.


Mandatory Knowledge

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent work experience;
  • 5 to 7 years of experience in development;
  • Proficiency in Python, GCP Bigtable and GCP Cloud Functions;
  • Hands on experience with designing data models, developing and automation and deployment of cloud functions.



Does this sounds like something you'd like to do?

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
The Role


We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to lead our go-to-market efforts in Brazil. This is a high-impact, senior individual contributor role for a proven enterprise seller who understands the Brazilian payments ecosystem inside and out—and sees where stablecoins fit into its future.

You'll own the full sales cycle from identifying opportunities to closing multi-year enterprise deals. Your targets are the fintechs, banks, and payment service providers (PSPs) that are shaping Brazil's financial infrastructure. You'll sell to senior finance and payments leaders, helping them understand how stablecoin rails can reduce costs, accelerate settlement, and unlock new revenue streams.

This is a building role. You'll be instrumental in defining our Brazil GTM strategy, informing product development for the region, and establishing Sphere as the trusted infrastructure partner for stablecoin payments in Latin America's largest economy.


What You'll Do

Own the Full Sales Cycle

  • Identify, prospect, and close enterprise deals with fintechs, banks, PSPs, and large corporates in Brazil
  • Manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes with procurement, legal, compliance, treasury, and C-suite buyers
  • Run discovery, demos, commercial negotiations, pilot programs, and implementation handoffs
  • Consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets


Build & Manage Pipeline

  • Leverage your existing network in Brazil's payments ecosystem to generate qualified opportunities
  • Develop territory and account plans that prioritize high-value, strategic accounts
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene and deliver accurate forecasts
  • Identify and manage local referral partners in the FX industry
  • Partner with Marketing on targeted campaigns, events, and content for the Brazilian market

Sell Value at the Executive Level

  • Position stablecoin infrastructure as a strategic advantage—articulating FX savings, settlement speed, treasury optimization, and new product opportunities
  • Build business cases and ROI models tailored to each prospect's operations
  • Develop trusted relationships with CFOs, Heads of Treasury, Heads of Payments, and Chief Product Officers
  • Navigate regulatory and compliance conversations with confidence

Be the Voice of Brazil

  • Represent Sphere at industry events, conferences, and in media engagements across Brazil
  • Provide market intelligence on competitive dynamics, regulatory developments (BCB, CVM), and customer needs
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Compliance to ensure our platform meets the specific requirements of Brazilian customers
  • Contribute to building a world-class sales playbook for the region


What We're Looking For

Must Have

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota selling to fintechs, banks, or PSPs
  • Deep payments and FX experience — you understand cross-border flows, treasury operations, correspondent banking pain points, and how money moves in and out of Brazil
  • Crypto/stablecoin experience — you've sold blockchain infrastructure, digital assets, or crypto-enabled payments products (or you've been a buyer of these solutions)
  • Existing relationships in Brazil's payments ecosystem — you have a book of business and a network of senior contacts at target accounts that you can activate from Day 1
  • Full-cycle enterprise selling skills — you're equally comfortable sourcing your own pipeline, running a technical demo, negotiating an MSA, and quarterbacking a pilot
  • Native Portuguese fluency and professional English proficiency
  • Based in Brazil , ideally São Paulo, with willingness to travel internationally

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to or working at Tier 1 Brazilian banks (Itaú, Bradesco, Santander, BTG) or leading fintechs (Nubank, PicPay, Mercado Pago, Stone, PagSeguro)
  • Understanding of Brazilian regulatory landscape — BCB instant payments (Pix), CVM regulations, crypto licensing developments
  • Background in treasury, FX trading, or payments operations
  • Experience at a high-growth startup scaling in Brazil
  • Spanish proficiency for broader LATAM opportunities


The Profile

You thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You're not waiting for inbound leads—you're building your own pipeline from relationships you've cultivated over years in the market. You can credibly speak to a Head of Treasury about FX exposure and settlement risk, then pivot to explaining stablecoin rails to a Chief Product Officer exploring embedded finance.


You're entrepreneurial but disciplined. You bring structure to chaos—territory plans, account maps, forecasting rigor—while staying flexible enough to adapt as we learn what works in the market.


You believe stablecoins are the future of payments infrastructure, and you want to be at the forefront of that shift in Latin America's most important market.

  • Existing relationships in Brazil's payments ecosystem — you have a book of business and a network of senior contacts at target accounts that you can activate from Day 1
  • Full-cycle enterprise selling skills — you're equally comfortable sourcing your own pipeline, running a technical demo, negotiating an MSA, and quarterbacking a pilot
  • Native Portuguese fluency and professional English proficiency
  • Based in Brazil , ideally São Paulo, with willingness to travel internationally

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to or working at Tier 1 Brazilian banks (Itaú, Bradesco, Santander, BTG) or leading fintechs (Nubank, PicPay, Mercado Pago, Stone, PagSeguro)
  • Understanding of Brazilian regulatory landscape — BCB instant payments (Pix), CVM regulations, crypto licensing developments
  • Background in treasury, FX trading, or payments operations
  • Experience at a high-growth startup scaling in Brazil
  • Spanish proficiency for broader LATAM opportunities

You thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You're not waiting for inbound leads—you're building your own pipeline from relationships you've cultivated over years in the market. You believe stablecoins are the future of payments infrastructure, and you want to be at the forefront of that shift in Latin America's most important market.

title: Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho
description:
• Descrição da Empresa: Setor de Reciclagem de Embalagem PET
  • Descrição do Cargo: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho Pleno, até 05 (cinco) anos de formado e 03 (três) anos de experiência em Identificação, Análise e Avaliação de Riscos
  • Local de Trabalho: São Carlos, São Paulo, portanto o profissional deve residir na região
  • Modelo de Contrato: Atuação como Pessoa Jurídica com CNPJ, para Prestação de Serviço, portanto, sem vínculo empregatício, e emissão de Nota Fiscal.
  • Previsão para início: março de 2026
  • Prazo do Contrato: 03 (três) meses com possibilidade para prorrogação por mais 03 (três) meses a depender do desempenho
  • Objetivo do Contrato: Realizar apoio técnico no desdobramento de Plano de Ação, sustentado por Relatório Técnico de Diagnóstico de SST para Cultura e Clima Favorável para SST, fundamentalmente para as ações de:
  • Estruturar o Inventário de Riscos Críticos das Áreas;
  • Elaborar Lista de Verificação para Inspeções de Segurança em função do Inventário de Riscos Críticos da Área;
  • Estruturar Registro de Não Conformidade para sustentar os achados nas Inspeções de Segurança;
  • Capacitar ao Gestor da Área e aos indicados por ele, para realizarem o preenchimento e a interpretação das Inspeções de Segurança, o Endereçamento das Inspeções para Plano de Ação; e
  • Estruturação de Indicadores de Desempenho, para sustentar informações ao Comitê Executivo de SST.
  • Remuneração mensal: R$ 4.000,00 (quatro mil e quinhentos reais) + 20% de adicional de Insalubridade + R$ 1.500,00 (um mil reais) como ajuda de custo
  • Enviar CV: com cópia para até às 18h:00

title: Technical Lead
description:
About Phi Partners

Phi Partners is the a market leader for capital markets technology services providing technology & quant services, solutions, and expertise to buy-side and sell-side financial institutions including some of the world’s largest investment banks, hedge funds and asset management firms. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in London, Phi has a presence in all major continents. Our niche focus on Front Office Technology has been a differentiator and gateway into the world’s best financial institutions.


About Phi Partners Brazil

Phi Partners has nearshore Centres-of-Excellence which are specialized in respective ‘Lines of Business’ (LoBs). Our latest São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence, houses our Quant, Front Office & Risk Technology Services (FORTS) & Murex teams. The São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence was opened with the goal to strengthened Phi's current relationship with our North America clients, as well with global clients with presence in São Paulo. Joining us means diving into truly groundbreaking work, pushing the limits of what modern technology can deliver while solving high-impact challenges for top-tier clients. You’ll build cutting-edge solutions for the world’s largest Investment Banks, leading Asset Managers, and market-defining Hedge Funds, working on projects where innovation is not an extra, but a fundamental expectation in everything we deliver.


About The FORTS Practice

Phi Partners is one of the largest consultancies specializing FORTS, with a dedicated team of over 175 consultants spread across multiple locations. Our team is distinguished by deep expertise in front-office and risk technology solutions, empowering top-tier financial institutions to optimize their trading and risk management capabilities.


At Phi Partners, we are committed to a collaborative, high-performance culture where professionals work together to deliver complex front-office solutions to elite clients. We specialize in the end-to-end implementation of front-office and risk platforms, from initial requirements gathering to post-go-live support, ensuring that our clients are fully supported throughout the platform lifecycle. We focus on custom development and configuration, creating solutions that address unique client needs and regulatory requirements in real-time trading and risk management.


Key Responsibilities

Phi is seeking an experienced an Engineering Manager / Technology Lead to establish and run a local delivery team in São Paulo working on a modern, cloud-native, cross-asset Pricing & Risk platform for a global financial-services client.


This role owns local delivery, team leadership, governance, and quality , allowing the global technical lead to focus on architecture and strategy. The successful candidate will be hands-on, delivery-oriented, and business-aware , with a strong Python-led engineering mindset and experience building and operating distributed systems in regulated environments.


This role gives you the opportunity to:

• Report directly to the Global Engineering & Technology Lead based in London

• Lead the São Paulo delivery team

• Own end-to-end delivery for the São Paulo team across development, testing, release, and BAU support

• Translate high-level architectural direction into practical, incremental delivery plans

• Ensure delivery against agreed milestones, quality standards, and non-functional requirements

• Act as the local point of accountability for delivery outcomes

• Own engineering governance , including:

• Code quality and review practices

• Testing strategy and coverage

• CI/CD and release discipline

• Documentation and operational readiness

• Ensure solutions meet security, resilience, and auditability expectations typical of Pricing & Risk systems

• Proactively identify and mitigate delivery and operational risks

• Remain technically engaged , contributing where appropriate (design reviews, complex debugging, critical path work)

• Act as a trusted local interface to client technology and business stakeholders


The Ideal candidate

Essential

• Proven experience as an Engineering Manager, Technology Lead , or similar role

• Strong hands-on engineering background, ideally with Python as a primary language

• Experience leading small to mid-sized development teams in a delivery-focused environment

• Demonstrated ownership of delivery, quality, and governance , not just design

• Experience building or operating cloud-native platforms

• Strong communication skills and confidence engaging with business and technical stakeholders

• Fluent English (spoken and written)


Highly Desirable

• Experience in capital markets, pricing, risk, trading, or market data systems

• Prior experience working with distributed or international teams

• Background in regulated or high-reliability environment

• Exposure to cross-asset systems or analytics platforms


Why should you join Phi Parnters

Join us as we build the next-generation team, an ambitious, fast-growing group delivering world-class, complex, and genuinely exciting projects to major financial institutions around the globe. We’re in a pivotal expansion phase, working with leading-edge technologies and giving you the chance to shape our strategy, influence key architectural decisions, and deploy solutions that truly impact global Capital Markets. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a world-leading Capital Markets Technology Consultancy while working alongside one of the strongest banking organizations in the industry.

title: Technical Manager
description:
Are you our new Technical Manager with Maersk H2S Safety Services in Macaé?


Key Responsibilities


AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY

  • Is responsible for the working environment in the Macae Base.
  • Is responsible for ensuring there are sufficient spare parts in stock for the smooth running of the operation. The financial implications of stock keeping should be considered in conjunction with the Senior General Manager.
  • Is responsible to ensure that all maintenance carried out by Safety Service’s workshop is in accordance with the Management System.
  • Is co responsible for keeping the Business Center equipment system updated.
  • Is responsible for input for monthly invoicing of third party maintained equipment at the Lab.
  • Is responsible for updating of all equipment certification.
  • Is responsible for arranging training courses for Base personnel.
  • To live the A. P. Moeller- Maersk values.


WORK AREA

  • Has the authority to instigate corrective actions required preventing the occurrence of a non-conformance detected within the area of responsibility.
  • Shall participate in all maintenance, repairs and modifications of H2S equipment owned by Maersk H2S Safety Services.
  • Shall arrange necessary training courses for workshop personnel.
  • In conjunction with the Senior General Manager produce input for all maintenance and workshop personnel related costs in respect of the annual budget.
  • Should act impartially and work according to the laboratory management system.
  • Ensure the effectiveness of laboratory activities.
  • Ensure that MHSS procedures are followed during the execution of internal and external activities.
  • Perform maintenance and calibration records


AUTHORIZATION

  • Issue calibration certificates.
  • Provide technical guidance to customers.
  • Issue declaration of conformity or opinions and interpretations.
  • Interrupt a nonconforming job.
  • Authorization to develop, modify, verify and validate methods and procedures.
  • Conduct analysis of results, including declarations of conformity and opinions and interpretations.
  • Issuance of reports, critical analysis and validation of results.
  • Implementation of the existing management system in the laboratory as well carry out its maintenance and improvement.
  • Identification of deviations from the management system and from the procedures for conducting laboratory activities.
  • Initiate actions to avoid and minimize deviations.
  • Review and approve staff overtime.


We are looking for

REQUIREMENT OF EDUCATION

  • Bachelor of Graduation as Engineering


REQUIREMENT OF EXPERIENCE

  • Requirement of qualification
  • Familiarity with the standards applicable to the calibration laboratory.
  • Knowledge of gas detection and respiratory protection equipment.
  • Knowledge of calibration laboratory procedures.
  • Requirement of experience
  • Proven experience working in laboratories accredited by INMETRO.
  • Experience with operations and maintenance of gas detection equipment.
  • Experience in management of personnel.
  • Experience in equipment maintenance and logistics.
  • Requirement of skills
  • Be able to perform calibration according to the calibration method on gas detectors.
  • Good knowledge of the Navision system
  • Technical knowledge and training
  • Knowledge of the current procedures in the calibration laboratory.
  • Knowledge of the MyLogical management system.
  • Training of the standard ABNT NBR ISO/IEC 17025.
  • Knowledge of the operation and maintenance of the equipment used by Maersk H2S Safety Services.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP CPI - Plenio/Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Estamos em busca de um profissional qualificado para atuar na integração de sistemas SAP, garantindo conectividade eficiente entre diferentes plataformas e aplicações empresariais. O candidato ideal terá experiência em arquiteturas de integração, desenvolvimento de interfaces e uso de ferramentas específicas do ecossistema SAP, e deve ter inglês em nível avançado para atuação em projetos internacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter integrações entre o SAP e outros sistemas (internos e externos).
  • Trabalhar com middleware e tecnologias de integração como SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI, BTP, API Management e Web Services (SOAP/REST).
  • Implementar e monitorar processos de troca de dados via IDocs, RFCs, OData e BAPIs.
  • Garantir a segurança, escalabilidade e eficiência das integrações.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e negócio para alinhar soluções às necessidades estratégicas da empresa.
  • Identificar e solucionar problemas de integração, otimizando processos e garantindo alta disponibilidade.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica e boas práticas de integração.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência comprovada com integração de sistemas SAP.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration), API Management e Web Services.
  • Experiência com IDocs, RFCs, OData e BAPIs.
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação e formatos de dados como XML, JSON, EDIFACT e CSV.
  • Conhecimento em ABAP, Java, JavaScript ou Groovy para customizações de integração.
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a serviços (SOA) e microsserviços.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para atuação em projetos internacionais.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Certificações SAP em integração (ex.: SAP Certified Development Associate - SAP Integration Suite).
  • Experiência com SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Conhecimento em integrações com SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, C/4HANA e outras soluções SAP.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP CPI - Plenio/Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Estamos em busca de um profissional qualificado para atuar na integração de sistemas SAP, garantindo conectividade eficiente entre diferentes plataformas e aplicações empresariais. Principais Responsabilidades


  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter integrações entre o SAP e outros sistemas (internos e externos).

  • Implementar e monitorar processos de troca de dados via IDocs, RFCs, OData e BAPIs.

  • Identificar e solucionar problemas de integração, otimizando processos e garantindo alta disponibilidade.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica e boas práticas de integração.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência comprovada com integração de sistemas SAP.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration), API Management e Web Services.

  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação e formatos de dados como XML, JSON, EDIFACT e CSV.
  • Conhecimento em ABAP, Java, JavaScript ou Groovy para customizações de integração.

title: Estagiário de arquitetura
description:
Estágio em Arquitetura – Presencial | São Paulo (SP)

O estúdio Flávia Prata Arquitetura & Design , fundado em 2017, desenvolve projetos de interiores residenciais com forte apuro estético, detalhamento técnico rigoroso e acompanhamento próximo de obra.

Nosso trabalho busca unir elegância, funcionalidade e soluções construtivas bem pensadas, com atenção minuciosa aos detalhes e à experiência do cliente ao longo de todo o processo.


Estamos em busca de um(a) estagiário(a) de Arquitetura que queira aprender de forma prática e profunda sobre o desenvolvimento completo de um projeto — da criação ao executivo.

A vaga é para o período de quatro horas diárias, preferencialmente no período vespertino. Oferecemos bolsa-auxílio compatível com o mercado e auxílio-transporte.

title: Engenheiro Agrônomo
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Agrônomo(a) para integrar nossa equipe, com atuação voltada à elaboração de laudos técnicos, análises agronômicas e suporte em demandas relacionadas à área agrícola e pericial.

O profissional será responsável por analisar dados técnicos, interpretar informações agronômicas, contribuir com relatórios especializados e atuar com foco em boas práticas agrícolas e sustentabilidade.

Buscamos um perfil analítico, organizado, com boa comunicação escrita e verbal, e que tenha interesse em atuar com demandas técnicas que exigem precisão e responsabilidade.

Requisitos:


  • Formação em Engenharia Agronômica
  • Registro ativo no CREA
  • Experiência na elaboração de laudos técnicos (desejável)
  • Conhecimento atualizado em boas práticas agrícolas e sustentabilidade
  • Capacidade de análise e interpretação de dados técnicos


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com perícias técnicas


Remuneração:

Média de R$ 5.000,00

title: Especialista Juridico Trabalhista
description:
O escritório Okumura Sociedade Advogados está contratando um Especialista Jurídico para atuar na área trabalhista , com foco no atendimento de demandas internas do departamento jurídico de um de seus clientes.


As atividades serão realizadas presencialmente na região da Zona Sul da Capital de São Paulo (próximo ao Shopping Morumbi)


Requisitos:

a) Experiência em contencioso e consultivo trabalhista, com atuação em escritório de advocacia e departamento jurídico de empresas;

b) Experiência com sistema Elaw;

c) Nível avançado/fluência na escrita do idioma inglês.


Soft Skills:

a) Adaptável;

b) Atenção a detalhes;

c) Atitude positiva;

d) Senso de urgência e prioridades para manter o atendimento ágil de nossos clientes;

e) Conhecimentos de usuário intermediário/avançado do MS Office (Principalmente, Excel, Power Point e Word);

g) Organização.


Principais atividades:

  • Interface entre departamento jurídico e escritórios de advocacia que atuam na defesa do cliente de modo a garantir o cumprimentos dos prazos processuais.
  • Auxiliar na carteira de processos trabalhistas (incluindo a implantação de sistema; preenchimento de pastas; auditorias internas dos processos);
  • FUP de indicações de testemunhas/prepostos e entrega de documentos para defesas judiciais (casos judiciais ativos: aproximadamente 600 processos);
  • Apoiar a revisão da pasta antes do encerramento no sistema;
  • Elaboração de minutas de respostas a ofícios e notificações extrajudiciais (desconto de pensão alimentícia/emissão de PPPs etc.);
  • Desenvolver estudos e pesquisas sobre a legislação vigente e entendimentos jurisprudenciais sobre temas trabalhistas em geral.
  • Atualização de indicadores da área e elaboração de relatórios gerenciais;
  • Preenchimento de planilha de laudos médicos e técnicos;
  • Preenchimento de planilha de acordos;
  • Preenchimento de planilha de consultas;
  • Elaboração de respostas às consultas sobre temas jurídicos;
  • Elaboração de informativos; manuais; apresentações em Powerpoint;

title: Especialista Juridico Trabalhista
description:
O escritório Okumura Sociedade Advogados está contratando um Especialista Jurídico para atuar na área trabalhista , com foco no atendimento de demandas internas do departamento jurídico de um de seus clientes.


As atividades serão realizadas presencialmente na região da Zona Sul da Capital de São Paulo (próximo ao Shopping Morumbi)


Requisitos:

a) Experiência em contencioso e consultivo trabalhista, com atuação em escritório de advocacia e departamento jurídico de empresas;

b) Experiência com sistema Elaw;

c) Nível avançado/fluência na escrita do idioma inglês.


Soft Skills:

a) Adaptável;

b) Atenção a detalhes;

c) Atitude positiva;

d) Senso de urgência e prioridades para manter o atendimento ágil de nossos clientes;

e) Conhecimentos de usuário intermediário/avançado do MS Office (Principalmente, Excel, Power Point e Word);

g) Organização.


Principais atividades:

  • Interface entre departamento jurídico e escritórios de advocacia que atuam na defesa do cliente de modo a garantir o cumprimentos dos prazos processuais.
  • Auxiliar na carteira de processos trabalhistas (incluindo a implantação de sistema; preenchimento de pastas; auditorias internas dos processos);
  • FUP de indicações de testemunhas/prepostos e entrega de documentos para defesas judiciais (casos judiciais ativos: aproximadamente 600 processos);
  • Apoiar a revisão da pasta antes do encerramento no sistema;
  • Elaboração de minutas de respostas a ofícios e notificações extrajudiciais (desconto de pensão alimentícia/emissão de PPPs etc.);
  • Desenvolver estudos e pesquisas sobre a legislação vigente e entendimentos jurisprudenciais sobre temas trabalhistas em geral.
  • Atualização de indicadores da área e elaboração de relatórios gerenciais;
  • Preenchimento de planilha de laudos médicos e técnicos;
  • Preenchimento de planilha de acordos;
  • Preenchimento de planilha de consultas;
  • Elaboração de respostas às consultas sobre temas jurídicos;
  • Elaboração de informativos; manuais; apresentações em Powerpoint;

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

description:

Salário: Acima da média Salarial.

  • Organizar agendas, compromissos e atividades administrativas;
  • Organizar documentos físicos
  • Atender clientes e fornecedores em assuntos financeiros e administrativos.


Competências técnicas desejadas

  • Experiência em contas a pagar e receber;
  • Experiência em Impostos e Tributações;
  • Experiência em RH/DP;
  • Organização de agendas e processos internos.


Comportamentos esperados

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Responsabilidade e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Boa comunicação com equipe e clientes.
  • Pro-atividade para resolver demandas e antecipar necessidades.


Carga horária:

  • Segunda a Sexta das 08:00 as 17:48.

title: Engenheiro de dados SR
description:
Cód. 58278


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Data Engineer, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Experiência em Big Data na Cloud Azure , atuando com componentes como ADLS, Event Hub e Azure Data Factory .

Criação e manutenção de pipelines de ingestão Batch e Near Real-Time (especialmente com Data Factory + Databricks ).

Desenvolvimento/manutenção de motores em SPARK , com domínio de Scala, PySpark e Spark SQL .

Experiência prática com Databricks e versionamento com Git (boas práticas de desenvolvimento/entrega).

Modelagem multidimensional (camada Gold) e experiência com CosmosDB .



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!
